args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was deployed to all production regions and began failing health checks (error rate 0.18, unhealthy). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and was unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified (`rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer, describing the rollback to v2.3.0.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status confirms `checkout-api` is now **healthy** on v2.3.0 in all regions with error rate back down to 0.002.
